items.title: Monetary Policy Report—October 2026
items.summary: Inflation in Canada has been higher than anticipated and is projected to remain around 3% through much of 2027. It then returns close to 2% by the middle of 2028. The outlook for growth has improved, but uncertainty remains elevated.
items.why: deterministic: corroborated across feeds

items.title: Monetary Policy Report Press Conference Opening Statement
items.summary: Governor Tiff Macklem discusses the Monetary Policy Report and the key issues involved in the Governing Council’s deliberations about the monetary policy decision.
items.why: deterministic: corroborated across feeds

items.title: Minutes of the Meeting of the Court of Directors held on 17 September 2026
items.summary: The Bank's Court of Directors acts as a unitary board, setting the organisation's strategy and budget and taking key decisions on resourcing and appointments. Required to meet a minimum seven times per year, it has five executive members from the Bank and up to nine non-executive members.
items.why: deterministic: corroborated across feeds

items.title: Bank of England sets out approach to tokenised collateral in central clearing
items.summary: The Bank of England has today launched a consultation supporting central counterparties (CCPs) acceptance of tokenised forms of eligible collateral.
items.why: New Bank of England consultation on accepting tokenised collateral in central clearing.

items.title: Statement by the Monetary Policy Board: Monetary Policy Decision
items.summary: Media release number 2026-30: At its meeting today, the Board decided to increase the cash rate target by 25 basis points to 4.85 per cent.
items.why: RBA cash rate hike directly alters monetary policy stance.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board finalizes changes to enhance the transparency and public accountability of its stress test and reduce volatility in its stress test-related capital requirements
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board finalizes changes to enhance the transparency and public accountability of its stress test and reduce volatility in its stress test-related capital requirements
items.why: Fed finalizes rule changes to bank stress tests and capital requirement volatility.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with Ontario Bancorporation, Inc.
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with Ontario Bancorporation, Inc.
items.why: Federal Reserve issued a formal enforcement action against a banking institution.

items.title: UK Government takes on till fraud with POS software standards
items.summary: The UK government is introducing mandatory software standards for point-of-sale systems in an effort to clamp down on till fraud.
items.why: New government regulation introducing mandatory POS software standards to curb till fraud.

items.title: Firms object to shares being part of OKX-ICE tokenised stock trading venture
items.summary: A host of companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and Microsoft, have registered their objection to their shares trading on a planned tokenised platform developed by Nyse parent Intercontinental Exchange and crypto exchange OKX.
items.why: Major corporations formally object to tokenised stock trading platform, creating significant industry conflict.

items.title: Crypto exchange HTX to leave UK after FCA lawsuit
items.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority has secured a High Court order preventing crypto exchange HTX from ‌knowingly promoting cryptoasset services unlawfully to customers in the country.
items.why: Regulatory enforcement action and court order forcing crypto exchange HTX out of the UK.

items.title: Hackers steal $6.3bn in crypto assets from Binance
items.summary: The world's largest crypto exchange has fallen victim to the world's largest crypto heist after North Korean hackers stole $6.3bn from Binance, an audacious attack that could undermine confidence in the digital assets market.
items.why: Massive unprecedented crypto heist impacting major global exchange.

items.title: PE firm CD R targets buyout of $40bn Global Payments - FT
items.summary: Global Payments, the payments processor with an enterprise value of around $40 billion, is an acquisition target for private equity firm CD R, according to the Financial Times.
items.why: Potential $40 billion mega-buyout of a major payments processor represents significant market M&A.

items.title: Regulator warns Australians about 'highly speculative' prediction markets
items.summary: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) says it is not currently convinced that prediction markets for retail clients are in the public interest, warning that people who access offshore platforms do not have legal protections.
items.why: ASIC signals skepticism on retail prediction markets, effectively setting regulatory policy against offshore and domestic platforms.

items.title: Binance users withdraw $5bn in wake of hack
items.summary: Binance users have withdrawn nearly $5 billion from the crypto exchange since it reopened after the hack last week that saw North Korea-linked crooks make off with $6.3 billion.
items.why: Massive $5bn capital flight following a record crypto hack signals acute market distress.

items.title: OPay withdraws planned $304m US IPO after regulatory inquiry
items.summary: OPay Limited has announced that it will be terminating its underwriting agreement and shelving plans for an initial public offering (IPO) on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) following a regulatory inquiry in a foreign jurisdiction the company described as “immaterial” to its core business.
items.why: Cancellation of a major $304m IPO triggered by a regulatory inquiry is a material policy event.

items.title: Goldman bans traders and bankers from using AI coding tools
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has banned traders and other employees from using advanced AI tools for coding over productivity and risk concerns, according to Bloomberg
items.why: Unexpected policy restriction on AI tool usage at a premier global investment bank.

items.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and AI tools in $6.3bn hack
items.summary: Binance says the $6.3 billion cyberattack it suffered last week was a sophisticated, multi-stage campaign that included fake job interviews, malicious software downloads and compromised AI tooling.
items.why: Binance discloses novel AI vectors and fake interviews behind massive $6.3 billion cyberattack.

items.title: FCA sets out rules for ESG rating providers
items.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority has finalised new rules for ESG rating providers designed to raise standards and help investors to make better informed decisions.
items.why: FCA finalises new regulatory rules for ESG rating providers.

items.title: OppFi abandons purchase of BNC Bank
items.summary: Digital finance platform OppFi has withdrawn its applications buy a bank, claiming it has not had a meaningful opportunity to engage with regulators to address concerns about the deal.
items.why: OppFi withdrew its bank purchase application after regulatory engagement challenges.

items.title: Stripe Treasury launches in the UK
items.summary: Stripe, the programmable financial services company, today launched Stripe Treasury in the UK, enabling founders to manage money from the same Dashboard where they already accept payments, without navigating across separate providers.
items.why: Stripe expanded its embedded treasury banking product to the UK market.

items.title: Corporate watchdog looking into failed Firmus float – as it happened
items.summary: Appearing before a Senate estimates hearing, Australian Securities and Investments Commission chief Sarah Court sheds some light on the alleged shenanigans behind the great $44 billion float flop.
items.why: ASIC reveals scrutiny into major $44 billion failed float at Senate estimates.

items.title: Billions of dollars stolen in largest cryptocurrency hack in history
items.summary: Up to $8.9 billion in crypto funds have been stolen from the cryptocurrency exchange, with approximately $4.2 billion frozen.
items.why: Record-breaking multi-billion-dollar cryptocurrency hack with major market and security implications.

items.title: 'Supertanker' strikes mine in Hormuz, losing two million barrels of oil
items.summary: Four oil tankers, including a 'supertanker' carrying more than two million barrels of oil, have hit mines and caught fire while travelling through the Strait of Hormuz.
items.why: Unexpected mine attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz present a major shock to global energy markets.

items.title: FBI accuses North Korea of Binance hack
items.summary: The FBI has backed the opinion of crypto experts, by officially accusing North Korean hackers of stealing more than $US6 billion from cryptocurrency exchange Binance.
items.why: FBI officially attributes massive $6B Binance cryptocurrency hack to North Korean hackers.

items.title: Watchdog says super funds are failing their members
items.summary: Australia's corporate regulator is threatening legal action against super funds that do not step up to resolve complaints.
items.why: ASIC threatens super funds with legal action over systemic dispute-handling failures.

items.title: TasWater bosses blame regulator for 'miscalculation' that saw massive bill hikes
items.summary: Senior leaders at Tasmania's water utility privately blamed the state's economic regulator for an "error" that threatened to cost customers tens of thousands of dollars, documents show.
items.why: Documents reveal economic regulator miscalculation caused massive water bill hikes for customers.
